title: speech.say body v1
description: TTS request. Publishers: jv-brain (Phase 1); later any service with speech capability. Consumer: jv-voice. Command topic: envelope conf = 1.0.

text.description: What to say. Plain text; spoken-style, no markup.

say_id.description: UUID minted by the requester for THIS spoken output. Output utterances (Jarvis speaking) are distinct from input utterances (the user speaking) — jv-memory (Phase 4) tells them apart by this split. speech.state reports progress against say_id.

in_reply_to_utterance.description: The input utterance_id (from audio.vad/audio.transcript) that triggered this speech, or null when there is no trigger (e.g. a system announcement). Required, nullable. End-to-end voice latency = VAD utterance_id -> matching in_reply_to_utterance.

priority.description: low: dropped if anything else is queued. normal: FIFO. urgent: preempts an interruptible utterance in progress.

interruptible.description: Whether a wake event or an urgent request may stop this mid-sentence (BRIEF-phase1: wake-while-speaking interrupts).

voice.description: Override of the personality/ default voice. Omit in normal operation — consistency is identity (blueprint §06).
